remarks:
Welcome to 15 Bird St., Westfield! 
This property offers nearly 3,000 square feet of living space which has been used as a single-family as well as a multi-family. Whether you are looking to reside on just the spacious first floor which offers 3 comfortably-sized bedrooms, a large living room with a wood-burning Heatilator fireplace, a cozy kitchen, and a large dining room built for entertaining with access to the outdoor patio and rent out the 2nd floor, or utilize the full space yourself, you have options! The second floor brings 2 more spacious bedrooms, a living room, and a dining room with a smaller bathroom and kitchen - but the kitchen has access to the 2nd floor deck which was rebuilt in 2023. You will also find a rear mudroom with access to the full basement which provides so much additional space for storage or also can be used for additional space.  The basement walls have been coated with Drylock to ensure that it stays nice and dry.  The wall-mounted furnace was replaced in 2015, the water heater has been updated, and a new sump pump will be installed soon.

Overlooking the property from the balcony you will see a large yard that is a half-acre in size as well as a dream of a garage for anyone who like to work on vehicles, use the space for a hobby, or simply park your cars in there. The back half of the building had been permitted for horses and was used as a barn. 

Extend your entertaining outside on the paver patio with a pergola overhead and enjoy the peace and quiet of a low-traffic area. Nestled within the village limits but tucked away from the hustle and bustle, this home is located within minutes of Lake Erie/Barcelona for beautiful sunsets, Beach Glass Hunting, and swimming and I-90 as well as dining, shopping, Welch Field, the Farmer's Market, live music, and more! Within 15 minutes of Chautauqua Lake and Chautauqua Institution as well as the Rails to Trails for outdoor activities.
